description.text: A special Sun & Moon set of 78 cards, 70 and 8 secret rares, released on 7 September 2018 and sold only in collections, with at least one holo in every pack. It gathers more than 20 Dragon-type Pokémon, among them Reshiram-GX, Salamence-GX and Dragonite-GX, drawn from most of the Japanese Dragon Storm and from Champion Road and Sky-Splitting Charisma cards left out of Celestial Storm, some with artwork from the Neo and ex years. The third set sold this way, after Generations and Shining Legends, it was the first of them with Prism Star cards and a gold secret rare, Ultra Necrozma-GX.
